summary: Folded the corrected restart receipt into the phantom-configuration account: with the transport wired back to the peer, the restarted node led again under the log-derived configuration and the peer's log reached index 5, so the entry first committed alone became a quorum commit of the committed configuration. The void restart attempt is no longer cited, the memory-only counterevidence is now a measured repair bound, and the untested case—never restarting or restarting with the peer unreachable—is stated as the remaining interval.
